## Checklist

- [ ] One focused change; the design was agreed in an issue first if it is more than a small fix.
- [ ] `make check` passes locally.
- [ ] Docs, examples and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated in the same change if user-visible behaviour changed (see "Documentation in the same change" in `CONTRIBUTING.md`).
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, databases or real customer data are included.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off under the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/) (`git commit -s` adds `Signed-off-by: Your Name <you@example.org>`).
